description: This file defines a PHP class ValidationUserNameAPI that handles API requests related to validating the uniqueness of user names in an administrative context. It includes methods for fetching validation results via GET requests, with validation rules for input parameters, and uses traits and external classes for user service interactions and API response formatting.

classes.name: ValidationUserNameAPI
classes.description: A class that provides an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of a username during user creation or editing, responding with a boolean indicating if the username is available for use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate whether a provided username (and optionally user ID) is unique. Retrieves request parameters, validates existence of the user if ID is provided, checks username availability, and returns a result object with the validation outcome.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET request parameters, enforcing string type and maximum length for username, and optional positive integer for user ID.
